AboutPage.title: About me
AboutPage.bio_p1: I am Nathan Dariel BAMANDJI, a Full Stack Engineer passionate about building modern, performant and secure web applications.
AboutPage.bio_p2: Graduated with a Master of Science (European MSc) from WOOLF University, Malta, I combine solid technical skills in software eengineering (JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Power BI) with expertise in DevOps, CI/CD Continuous Integration and Deployment continuous, Data, reporting and visualieation and Cybersecurity Working to raise awareness of cyberattacks and threats and promote digital hygiene. Engaged in social and technological impact projects at regional and international levels following my Cybersecurity training led by UNDP, Give1project and Open Society Foundation.

ProjectsPage.subtitle: Professional achievements and research projects.
ProjectsPage.project_1_desc: Full development of the digital agency's website in software development. Implementation of a CI/CD pipeline with Jenkins, software testing, quality assurance and quality control in a complete DevOps approach.
ProjectsPage.project_2_desc: Design and development of the professional website for this engineering firm. Modern, responsive interface optimized for performance. Server-side rendering with Next.js.
ProjectsPage.project_3_desc: Research and implementation of a continuous integration, validation and deployment system with DevOps and Jenkins. Focused on software testing, quality assurance (QA) and quality control in production.
ProjectsPage.project_4_desc: Regional training program in cybersecurity and digital peacebuilding in Africa, conducted with UNDP, Give1Project and Open Society Foundation. Check Point international certification obtained.

ProjectsPage.project_6_desc: Design and development of the website for OCLA Congo, a non-profit NGO promoting human rights, improving the civil status system, and eradicating statelessness in Congo-Brazzaville. Built with WordPress.
ProjectsPage.project_7_desc: Hands-on cybersecurity training during an intensive Bootcamp. Worked with Wireshark for network protocol analysis and suspicious traffic diagnosis, Splunk for log analysis, security dashboards, and real-time anomaly detection. Performed vulnerability scanning with Nessus/OpenVAS and remediation management. Conducted network audits and penetration testing with Nmap/Metasploit to identify attack vectors, and used Burp Suite for web application security testing.
ProjectsPage.project_8_desc: Complete e-commerce platform dedicated to baby products (baby layettes, clothing, newborn essentials) built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React.js, Node.js). Parents can order baby essentials without leaving home. Front-end hosted on Vercel and back-end deployed on Render. Project developed as part of my European Master of Science (MSc) WOOLF, intended for commercialization.
ProjectsPage.project_9_desc: A platform that helps individuals quickly find an available artisan close to their home. It simplifies requesting, tracking, reviews, and the visibility of local service providers. For example, if I need a plumber, I stay home, open the app, and contact a verified plumber who comes to me: they gain visibility and I get an easy way to find an artisan. Built with Django and React.js.
